about: Stories come from the shared bank: games/shared/stories.json (50+ per level, shuffled every game). This file has the How to play slides and bonus cards.

intro.title: Read & Remember
text: Remember as much as you can!

example.big: Tom got a new dog on Saturday...

intro.title: Write and win
text: Write the answers on your board.

before.name: One reader
before.text: Only ONE student can read. They tell the team: +2

before.name: Extra detail
before.text: Remember one more detail from the story: +1

secret.name: Fastest team
secret.text: +2 for the first team with all answers right!

secret.name: Perfect spelling
secret.text: +1 if every answer is spelled correctly!

secret.name: Remember the title
secret.text: +1 if your team can say the story title!
